feladatok.cim: Email to Jack accepting a cookout invitation
feladatok.helyzet: You are studying in California and you’ve received the following invitation from one of your classmates, Jack Brown:

bekezdesek: Fire up the grill because it’s cookout season – Let’s get together, we don’t need a reason!
At the home of Sarah and William Brown

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of 50-80 words in which you
iranyito_szempontok: ask how to get there; if you can bring your boyfriend/girlfriend; if you are supposed to bring anything.

feladatok.cim: Letter to Martha about choosing a career
feladatok.helyzet: You’ve received a letter from your English friend Martha. Here is the last part of it:

bekezdesek: Well, lately I have been getting told that I "need to know what I want to be when I grow up". I haven't got a clue. You know I like being outside, animals, drawing, photography, writing stories and poetry, I do enjoy maths, I ride horses – I’d like to have one, as a matter of fact, so any job you think of had better pay well, ha ha. Some things that I do not enjoy are office work, going from day to day with no excitement - and I don't want a job that will take me 10 years after leaving secondary school just to learn! Do you have any good ideas? Your help would be greatly appreciated!!!

feladatok.teendo: Write a letter of 100-120 words to Martha in which you give her some advice, including the following:
iranyito_szempontok: Recommend one job that you think might suit her.
Describe the advantages and possible disadvantages of this job.
Say if you personally would be interested in this job and why.
